## Dates

Each commit is dated at noon (Asia/Dushanbe) on the day the change took effect. The other dates, enacted and published, are trailers.

When a law gives no date of its own, the default rule applies: Constitutional amendments adopted by national referendum; this build dates the edition by the referendum day the source names. http://parlament.tj/konstitutsiyai-jt/

## How the history is built

`tools/build.py` turns the corpus into this history in one pass: one commit per law, on the day it took effect. The same corpus always gives the same commit hashes. `tools/check_repo.py` reads every version back from git and compares it with the corpus. `tools/on.py` shows the law as it stood on any date. The corpus format is described in `tools/SCHEMA.md`.

- Corpus: sha256 `39b0565b5134a3579314b175ed3ecb55224107f6f387be8e29874a13b6878336` (359377403 bytes).

## Decisions made by hand

- Tajik is the official language; the Tajik text is built. Russian texts exist (adlia.tj) but anonymous access shows only 1,500 characters.
- Constitution: the oldest text available is the 1999+2003 edition published by the Majlisi namoyandagon; it is the first version (first_law null), dated 2003-06-22, the referendum day the source names for the edition.
- The 1994 original and the 1999 edition were not found online at an official source; they are named in earlier_laws.
- Belarusian ў in the publisher text is normalised to Tajik ӯ.
- andoz.tj PDFs: text layer only (no OCR). Two legacy Tajik font encodings are mapped back to standard letters per document; running headers and page numbers are dropped; PDF lines are joined into paragraphs. Chapter and section headings go into the file of the article that follows them.
- andoz.tj acts other than the Tax Code are single consolidated editions, dated by the latest date their heading or amendment list names (In-force-basis trailer); they are "oldest version available" commits credited to the publisher.
- andoz.tj Tax Code: three acts (2004 code, 2012 code, 2021 code in force from 2022-01-01); each listed edition is a version, dated by the date the publisher gives; editions named after an amending law are credited to that law, the rest to the publisher.
- WIPO Lex Tajik PDFs (secondary copies, Source-status trailer): text layer only, read like the andoz.tj PDFs. A WIPO version is dated by the date of the last amending law WIPO Lex names for it (In-force-basis trailer), or by the entry-into-force / adoption day it gives for an unamended text. Official versions win; WIPO versions older than the latest version already published are held, since adding them would need a history rewrite.
- Ministry of Justice register (portali-huquqi.tj/publicadliya): one version per act, the current edition. An act never amended is dated by the start-of-action day on its card and credited to itself; an amended act is dated by the in-force day the card gives for its edition (or the start-of-action day of the act that made it) and committed as "oldest version available"; an act that lapsed gets a second version on its lapse day with no provisions, credited to the repealing act when the register links it. Amending, repealing and adopting acts are not acts of their own here; international instruments and records with no date or no text are held. Editions older than a version already published are held.
- Ministry of Justice register: new laws go in qonunho/<year of adoption>/<number>-<name>/, government resolutions in qarorhoi-hukumat/<year>/, presidential decrees in farmonhoi-prezident/<year>/, presidential orders in farmoishhoi-prezident/<year>/, Majlisi Oli resolutions in qarorhoi-majlisi-oli/<year>/, Supreme Court and Supreme Economic Court plenum resolutions in qarorhoi-plenumi-sudi-oli(-iqtisodi)/<year>/, Prosecutor General orders in farmoishhoi-prokurori-generali/<year>/, Council/Cabinet of Ministers resolutions in qarorhoi-shuroi-vaziron/<year>/, other acts in sanadhoi-digar/<year>/; new codes and constitutional laws at the root beside the codes already held. Where the register holds no Tajik text the Russian text is used (marked in the version note).

## What AI did and did not do

The scripts that read the sources and build this repository were written by Claude Code running Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) under Lexifina's direction.

No model wrote, translated or corrected legal text. No model runs at build time. Every word of law in this repository comes from the official sources above.

The commit messages are written by `build.py` from the source data.

Model use at data-build time:
- none: no model wrote or transformed legal text; Claude Opus 5.5 wrote the scripts.
